Product Disclaimer: Product packaging may vary.
To celebrate MagicCon in the Windy City, we’re serving up a tasty Festival in a Box with all the fixings.
Inside each Mystery Booster 2 display box you’ll find 24 booster packs featuring cards with nearly 200 set symbols. Each 15-card pack includes one white-border card, one playtest card, and one Future Sight frame card which might even be one of 15 exclusively foil cards. Drafting will feel like you’re cracking packs from Magic’s past, Magic’s future, and Magic’s weird alternate timeline where everyone has a moustache and an Italian beef sandwich.
Plus, you’ll get the Animar & Friends Foil Edition Secret Lair Drop. With playful new art from Jack Teagle and five cards that synergize around Animar, Soul of Elements, this drop can inspire your next commander deck or just give you something to admire while dipping your Italian beef into some delicious au jus.
To top it all off, four promo cards including a Foil Retro Frame Serra the Benevolent, a Foil Future Sight Frame Ponder, a Foil Future Sight Frame The First Sliver, and a “Second City” playtest card. These cards are hot. Probably as hot as the spicy giardiniera on an Italian beef sandwich. Yum!
All cards are English only.
Festival in a Box: Chicago 2025 is limited to 3 per customer.
Contents:
• 1x Rainbow Foil Animar, Soul of Elements
• 1x Rainbow Foil Benevolent Hydra
• 1x Rainbow Foil Forgotten Ancient
• 1x Rainbow Foil All Will Be One
• 1x Rainbow Foil Mulldrifter
4x Promo Cards
• 1x Foil Serra the Benevolent
• 1x Foil Ponder
• 1x Foil The First Sliver
• 1x Second City playtest card

When purchasing this unique product, please keep in mind that this Secret Lair Drop Series Sealed Product will ship out to you after the seller receives the product directly from Wizards of the Coast.

The estimated time frame for sellers to receive stock is not fixed, so it could be anywhere between 1 - 10 weeks for delivery.
